news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Pressure Amid Shifting OTT Strategies
news.summary: Digital streaming platforms are drastically cutting budgets and offering lower prices for post-theatrical rights, posing a major financial threat to Tollywood producers. With big-budget and medium-range projects struggling to secure expected digital deals—and valuations increasingly linked to theatrical box-office results—filmmakers may need to rely strictly on box office collections for financial recovery. Industry observers note this shift could compel producers to focus on controlled budgets and better content quality.

news.title: Hyderabad Cinema Hall Fined for Excessive Screening of Advertisements
news.summary: A Hyderabad moviegoer who faced a 22-minute delay before a screening of Kubera took a local theatre to the consumer court over wasted time. The court ruled in favor of the viewer, penalizing the cinema establishment with a total of Rs. 75,000 in fines and compensation. This ruling has brought renewed attention to the widespread practice of running lengthy commercial blocks prior to scheduled film showtimes.
